unavailable_fields.nvlink_bytes: NVLink counters not supported: nvmlDeviceGetNvLinkState returned NVML status 3 on both devices; NCCL log shows channels 00/01 via SHM/direct/direct, so no NVLink traffic exists to count
unavailable_fields.pcie_bytes: NVML exposes device-wide rates (KB/s) with native sampling windows, not byte counts; capability-probe values (1757/1513 and 390/292 KB/s) were taken outside the workload and are not workload traffic
unavailable_fields.per_collective_wire_bytes: device_telemetry readings are device-wide with driver sampling windows and cannot be attributed per collective; logical_input_bytes (497759232 per rank) is payload size, not measured traffic
unavailable_fields.nccl_wait_vs_transfer_decomposition: Nsys timelines alone do not separate NCCL waiting from wire transfer; no hardware counter probe is available to split kernel duration into wait and transfer components
unavailable_fields.hardware_utilization: Hardware counters require a successful collector-specific probe; NVML utilization periods are device-dependent and not aligned to operator ranges
unavailable_fields.bucket_member_cost_allocation: All 13 collectives have exactly one observed bucket via gradient-storage membership, but the passive inventory does not allocate a collective's cost among its member parameter groups (12 equal-size candidate buckets exist per 28351488-byte collective)
unavailable_fields.gpu_readiness_and_consumer_completion: execution_timeline reports clock alignment bounds for matching CPU submissions only; GPU readiness and consumer completion of submitted work may remain unknown
unavailable_fields.collective_calibration_critical_path: The synthetic warmed full-world SUM allreduce is a reference experiment with correctness checks, not a performance lower bound or model critical-path estimate

plan.rationale: Objective is step_ms (max across ranks) for the 2-GPU accumulated step with gradient/parameter checks preserved. Torch trace already ran: all 13 DDP allreduces (12x 28351488B buckets + 157541376B remainder, f32, RING_LL kernel entries over SHM/direct/direct, peer_access 0.0 both ways) are payload-observed and cross-rank matched with zero unmatched communication kernels; rank0 communication kernel sum is 209.43ms vs rank1 63.72ms for identical collectives and compute overlap is only 9.08/8.29ms, so ~200ms of communication is exposed and most of rank0's kernel duration is plausibly waiting. The plan targets the two open questions this raises. (1) Wait/overlap attribution: nsys is available (2025.3.1, status available) and is selected to resolve cross-rank kernel interval alignment, compute/communication overlap and launch-to-start gaps; execution_timeline adds CPU-to-CUDA submit associations, synchronization and per-device intervals plus passive post-accumulate callbacks that keep bucket linkage without replacing a communication hook. (2) Transport decisions and reference cost: nccl_tuning is selected because kernel entry names alone do not establish the actual NCCL algorithm/protocol/channel decisions in a warmed worker (LL at 28-157MB over SHM is a candidate tuning question); collective_calibration runs the synthetic full-world SUM allreduce at the actually observed sizes/dtypes as a correctness-checked reference to distinguish collective service time from skew waiting, without treating it as a lower bound. device_telemetry is selected narrowly for device-wide NVML pcie.tx/rx rates and gpu_utilization during the timed window to corroborate whether the SHM/PCIe path actually carries traffic, not to attribute bytes per collective. python_runtime is excluded: no trace evidence implicates host dispatch or binding costs and its cProfile times perturb execution and are not clean scores; candidate_diagnostics is excluded for lack of capability or trace evidence tying it to this objective; torch already ran and is not re-requested.

usage.scope: Observed assistant message snapshots; provider estimates, not invoice
